purpose: Deterministic overlap/coverage probe; these are experimental fixture chunks, not approved production context budgets.
largeWindowRule: One-based windows start at 1 + 6*k; end at min(start+7,N); stop when end=N. Never create new excerpt identities for overlap.
recursionProbe: Use the same experimental chunk plan; group at most four child summaries per reduction node and repeat until one root. Record actual tokenizer input/output counts and every node's source-reference union. If the candidate cannot fit a node, record the incompatibility; do not silently truncate.
deduplicationExpected: A launch statement repeated in s000002/s000003/s000008 remains one date-10 claim. Overlapping s000007/s000013/s000014 retain their original references. Numbered batch decisions must not be collapsed into one undifferentiated claim.

incompleteProbe.omit: Final chunk at every input size
incompleteProbe.required: Declare coverage incomplete; report covered and missing ranges; never label the decision list or absence claim exhaustive.

boundaryProbe: Place cancellation after each committed chunk and each reduction node; also request cancellation while a native call is active. Interrupted child output must not enter the committed reference union.
